/SWPLO+rp->p_pid\*SWPSIZ/s//swapblk(rp)/p
$a
7870

        swbuf.b_blkno = swapblk(rp);
/*
 * The swap area of a process is that of its slot in proc[]:
 * newproc takes the lowest free slot, so the same few slots,
 * and their swap blocks, are used again and again. (By p_pid,
 * which counts up to NPROC and round again, each new process
 * swapped to blocks nothing had used since its pid came round.)
 */
swapblk(rp)
struct proc *rp;
{
        register struct proc *p;
        register n;

        n = SWPLO;
        for(p = &proc[0]; p < rp; p++)
                n =+ SWPSIZ;
        return(n);
}
.

q
8324

                        bp = bread(swapdev, swapblk(p));
